items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And you'd put that all on the truck? Oh yeah. Whereabouts on the truck would you sit, Alan?

ctx.x: That's right. You see, we didn't have no big tum tum or nothing like that. We just had them little bit of tum tum on the side of a wood block and one cymbal, and that overhead pedal. And you'd snag drum, and you'd stand, that's it.
And you'd put that all on the truck? Oh yeah. Whereabouts on the truck would you sit, Alan?
The first. First. First. First. Thank you.
